第50章 林小冉打架-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

接下来的一个月，九州创投上海分部像一台被拧到最高转速的引擎，所有线同时往前推。

五亿授信到账的第三天，第一笔钱就压了出去。

芯海微电子的投资条款在周明远手里只用了两天就锁死了，华盈资本那边连第二轮面谈都没约上，创始人已经签了九州的TS。

消息传出去的时候，半导体圈子里有人嘀咕“九州出手太快”，但更多的人盯着那份条款里的数字，安静了。

三号楼和七号楼的优先入驻权拿下来之后，苏晚棠带着团队三天跑了十一家企业，第一批标杆公司开始进场。

做工业软件的、做无线通信模组的、做数据中台的——不是随便塞进去填空置率，而是按林川定好的产业链逻辑，一家一家卡进去。

七号楼三层给了一家从中科院拆出来的芯片设计团队，楼上四层是做EDA工具的，再往上是封测环节的供应商。

三家公司的老板第一次在电梯里碰面的时候，互相看了一眼工牌，当场就交换了名片。

这不是巧合，是苏晚棠按着林川画的那张产业链图谱排的楼层。

张立恒这一个月几乎天天往九州跑。园区底层数据、政府接口、入驻企业的合同细节、甚至连物业管理的改造方案，全被九州捋顺了。

他办公桌上那套自己做的招商手册被苏晚棠拿走重新编了一版，拿回来的时候厚了三倍，封面上印着“东方科创港·产业生态白皮书”，右下角的lOgO是九州创投。

张立恒翻了两页，没说话，把手册锁进了抽屉最里面那一格。

从那以后他见林川就不叫“林总”了，改口叫“老板”。

苏晚棠有一次在电梯里碰到张立恒的招商主管小赵，小赵压着声音说了句：“张总现在开会，动不动就是'林总那边怎么说的'，我们这些人都快成传话筒了。”

苏晚棠笑了一下，没接话。

顾城那条线的推进比预想的还快。

配套服务平台正式跑起来之后，财税代理、人力外包、法务咨询、供应链对接这几块业务像水管一样接上了管道。

园区每导入一家企业，顾城那边就自动多一笔服务费。第一个月流水不算大，但顾城是做生意的人，他一眼就看出来这不是一笔生意，而是一条管道。

只要园区在长，管道就在流。

九月初的一个晚上，顾城约林川在外滩喝酒，坐下来的第一句话不是聊天，是给林川倒了杯酒，自己先干了。

“我跟你说句真心话。”

林川端着杯子没动。

“当初你让我做配套平台，我以为你是让我有个事干就行。

”顾城把杯子放下，“这一个月下来我才看明白——往后这个园区越大，我这边收益只会越来越大。”

林川喝了一口酒：“看明白就好。”

“看明白了。”顾城靠在椅背上，语气少见地认真，“所以你后面要扩盘子，缺人、缺资源、缺关系，你先找我。”

林川没客气，碰了一下杯。

真正让林川感觉到“势”起来的，不是数字，是人。

赵屿第一个找上来的。他通过顾城递话，说家里航运板块有一批闲置的物流仓储资源，想看看能不能跟园区企业对接。

In the next month, the Shanghai branch of Jiuzhou Venture Capital was like an engine being turned to the highest speed, with all the lines pushed forward at the same time.

On the third day after the 500 million credit was received, the first payment was made.

The investment terms of Chipsea Microelectronics were locked up in Zhou Mingyuan’s hands in just two days. Huaying Capital didn’t even schedule a second round of interviews, and the founder had already signed a TS contract with Jiuzhou.

When the news spread, some people in the semiconductor circle muttered that "Jiuzhou took action too quickly," but more people stared at the numbers in the terms and fell silent.

After winning the priority right to move into Buildings 3 and 7, Su Wantang led his team to visit 11 companies in three days, and the first batch of benchmark companies began to enter the market.

Those who make industrial software, those who make wireless communication modules, and those who make data middle offices - they are not just randomly inserted to fill the vacancy rate, but one by one according to the logic of the industrial chain determined by Lin Chuan.

The third floor of Building 7 is given to a chip design team that was split from the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The fourth floor upstairs is for EDA tools, and the ones above are suppliers for the packaging and testing process.

When the bosses of the three companies met in the elevator for the first time, they glanced at each other's badges and exchanged business cards on the spot.

This is no coincidence. Su Wantang arranged the floors according to the industrial chain map drawn by Lin Chuan.

Zhang Liheng traveled to Kyushu almost every day this month.The park’s underlying data, government interfaces, contract details of settled companies, and even property management renovation plans have all been smoothed out by Jiuzhou.

The self-made investment brochure on his desk was taken away by Su Wantang and re-edited. When he got it back, it was three times thicker. The cover said "Oriental Science and Technology Innovation Port·Industrial Ecology White Paper", and the lOgO in the lower right corner was Jiuzhou Venture Capital.

Zhang Liheng turned over two pages, said nothing, and locked the manual into the innermost compartment of the drawer.

From then on, when he saw Lin Chuan, he stopped calling him "Mr. Lin" and changed his name to "Boss".

Su Wantang once met Zhang Liheng's investment manager Xiao Zhao in the elevator. Xiao Zhao said in a low voice: "Mr. Zhang is in a meeting now, and he always talks about 'What did Mr. Lin say?' We are almost on the receiving end of the microphone."

Su Wantang smiled and did not answer.

Gu Cheng's line is advancing faster than expected.

After the supporting service platform was officially launched, the businesses of finance and taxation agency, human resources outsourcing, legal consulting, and supply chain docking were connected like water pipes.

Every time an enterprise is introduced into the park, Gucheng will automatically receive an additional service fee.The turnover in the first month was not huge, but Gu Cheng was a businessman, and he could tell at a glance that this was not a business, but a pipeline.

As long as the park grows, the pipes will flow.

One night in early September, Gu Cheng asked Lin Chuan to have a drink on the Bund. His first words when he sat down were not to chat, but to pour Lin Chuan a glass of wine and drink first.

"Let me tell you the truth."

Lin Chuan held the cup without moving.

“When you asked me to be the supporting platform, I thought you just wanted me to have something to do.

Gu Cheng put down the cup, "It's only after this month that I realized that as the park gets bigger in the future, my income will only get bigger and bigger.""

Lin Chuan took a sip of wine: "Just understand."

"I understand." Gu Cheng leaned back in his chair and spoke in a rare serious tone, "So if you want to expand your business later, if you are short of people, resources, or connections, you should come to me first."

Lin Chuan was not polite and clinked the glasses.

What really made Lin Chuan feel "powerful" was not numbers, but people.

Zhao Yu was the first to find him.He communicated through Gu Cheng, saying that his family's shipping sector had a number of idle logistics and warehousing resources, and he wanted to see if he could connect with the enterprises in the park.
